entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Finally! I want to return this helmet I bought. Your service is unbelievable. I demand a refund right now.
I'm sorry to hear you're frustrated, sir. I can definitely look into that return for you. To get started, could I please have your name and order number?
The name is Mark Peterson, order 88-1-5-7-3-2. This is ridiculous. I've had this thing sitting here forever and I just want my money back.
Thank you, Mark. I'm pulling up your order now. I see the Velo-Pro helmet. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is there a technical fault or is it a matter of preference?
It's the color! It looked completely different on your website. It's an ugly, washed-out blue. I wouldn't be caught dead in it. The box is still unopened, I haven't even touched the thing.
Okay, I understand. So the issue is with the color, not a defect. Let me just check the purchase date here... I see the delivery was 71 days ago.

And? Your policy says 90 days! Are you trying to get out of this? Because I will speak to a manager. For a piece of safety equipment like a helmet, you'd think you'd want customers to be happy with it. I'll write a review on every website you can think of.

No, not at all, Mark. You are absolutely correct. Our policy for a standard item like this helmet is indeed 90 days, and you are well within that window. I can approve this return for a full refund immediately. There's no issue.
Oh. So... you're just going to process it? No hassle?

That's correct. I've just initiated the return in our system. I am emailing a prepaid shipping label to the address we have on file for you now. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off.
Huh. Okay. Well, good. That's what I expected.
Of course. Once we receive the helmet, you'll see the full refund to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's it. Just make sure that email comes through.
It has just been sent. Thank you for calling VeloFit, Mark. Have a good day.
